sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever assembled an engine.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次自己组装发动机。

sentences.en: The bridal guests assembled in gallant troops from distant quarters.
sentences.zh: 新娘宾客从四面八方赶来集合。

sentences.en: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.
sentences.zh: 警方收集了大量证据对付他。
